title: Chronic kidney disease: stage, hypertension and dialysis status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's kidney disease and any related hypertension and dialysis status.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for chronic kidney disease.

HPI
The patient is a 68-year-old male presenting for a scheduled follow-up regarding his chronic kidney disease. He reports feeling generally stable but mentions some increased fatigue and mild swelling in his ankles over the past month. He denies any acute shortness of breath or chest pain. He is currently adherent to his prescribed medications and has been monitoring his blood pressure at home.

Medication List
Lisinopril 20mg daily, Furosemide 40mg daily, Calcium Carbonate 500mg daily.

Exam
The patient is alert and oriented. Vital signs are stable. Physical exam reveals dry mucous membranes and no audible crackles in the lungs. There is trace pitting edema noted in the bilateral lower extremities. No new skin lesions or rashes are observed.

Assessment
Chronic kidney disease, stage 5. The patient is currently experiencing some peripheral edema, which may be related to his renal progression.

Plan
Continue current medication regimen. Patient instructed to monitor daily weight and report any rapid weight gain. Follow up in four weeks for a repeat laboratory panel to monitor renal function and electrolytes.
explanations: CKD stage 5 (not documented as ESRD): N18.5.
